models.gpt-6-luna: Lowest-cost starting choice for narrow coding jobs and focused read-only lookup with complete context. Return to the lead after one failed repair or expanded scope; a starting policy, not a guarantee.
models.gpt-6.1-sol: General implementation and ambiguous investigation at medium effort; architect, plan and security review at high effort. Prefer accepted-result cost, including repair and review. Prefer Sol for Nix activation/module wiring and Nix/store/USB contracts even when the edit is small; early matched trials exposed missed native contracts on Luna.
models.gpt-6-astra: Reserve low effort initially for the hardest architecture or unresolved failures; deeper effort requires evidence that it is needed.
